answer: Replication cost runs at 1 live process per identity, 30 days of uptime and a pulse every epoch. Rewards unlock only after that streak, so a farm of 2,000 clones owes 2,000 processes at the nadir of its budget before the first coin moves. One gap in the tide of uptime resets the counter. A gale of new accounts buys nothing until each one has run a month.
